messages:
Maria H: Quick heads-up — I'm starting an access curation pass focused on admin roles that show no activity in >90d. Expect a few owner pings and a staged dry-run today.
Alex P: Thanks — which groups are in scope? infra-admin, k8s-admin, svcacct-admin?
Maria H: Infra-admin, k8s-admin, kms-admin-proxy, svcacct-admin. Not touching billing-admin unless owners confirm no activity.
Ben S: Can you share the inactivity query? Our audit logs are split across cloud-audit and identity-service, want to match definitions.
Maria H: Using cloud-audit as primary and identity-service for console/login checks. Draft query: ```sql
-- sample inactivity query
SELECT principal, role, MAX(ts) as last_seen
FROM redwood_audit.cloud_audit
WHERE role IN ('infra-admin','k8s-admin','kms-admin-proxy','svcacct-admin')
GROUP BY principal, role
HAVING MAX(ts) < current_timestamp - interval '90 days';
```
Lina C: For kms-admin-proxy we should be cautious — removing that role can break CI token exchange. Can we run smoke tests before any prod change?
Maria H: Yes. Proposed plan: stage 1 = flag + owner pings (48h), stage 2 = dry-run removal in staging with automated smoke tests, stage 3 = prod removal with 24h soft-delete and rollback hook.
Jorge R: Also check kms.grants and cross-account bindings. Some services use grant-proxy; immediate removal could orphan crossacct grants and force a key rotation.
Maria H: Good point. I'll exclude any principals with kms.grants.crossacct = true from instant removal and create ops tickets for rebinds.
security-oncall: Reminder: SSO team policy requires a 24h hold before permanent deletions for admin accounts to allow emergency restores.
Maria H: Noted — will add a 24h soft-delete delay and a revert button in the ticket template.
audit-bot: Audit entry created: action=access_curation; actor=Maria H; id=curation-1763501123
Alex P: Can you drop the runbook link? I want to review the exact smoke-test steps and rollback commands with my team before stage 2.
Maria H: Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/access-curation — check section "KMS_BINDING_VALIDATION" and subsection "smoke-kms". Checklist I'll use: owners ack, smoke success, audit-entry, 24h soft-delete.
Ben S: I'll take svcacct-admin smoke tests tonight (have staging creds). Ping me when you create the staging job.
Maria H: Will create the staging job and post the job id here. Targeting owner pings by 12:30 PST and dry-run at 1763502000.
Jorge R: Also add a quick detection for principals that only perform token-exchange (to avoid false positives). I'll DM a snippet for that filter.
Maria H: Thanks Jorge — will incorporate that filter. If no objections I'll start owner pings now.
Lina C: No objections from infra. :+1:
security-oncall: I'll stand by and monitor alerts during the staged run.
Maria H: Closing loop — staged dry-run scheduled at 1763502000, will report results back here by 1763502600. :thumbsup:
